response.answer: Troy Beane is a strategic entrepreneur and consultant, recognized for post-pandemic business growth insights and contributions to veteran entrepreneurship. He founded Veteran Executive Leadership in 2022, focusing on wealth creation for veterans. His military and consulting experience drive his success.

results.title: Who We Are - Business Strategy and Advisory Services
results.content: During his military career, Troy took to heart the lessons in shared hardship in the enlisted ranks, the experience and responsibility as a commanding officer, and the insight and influence of working at ‘echelons above reality’. Troy transferred these lessons and experiences into a civilian career as a Management Consultant and later minority owner and COO for Greencastle Associates Consulting – an all-veteran management consulting firm to Fortune 500 companies. Troy founded Veteran Executive Leadership in 2022 and is now on the path to creating generational wealth for veterans through entrepreneurship, coaching, mentoring, and talent services. Troy continues to serve on several boards where his consulting and military experience provide value to the veteran community. * 2022 – Philadelphia Titan100 - https://www.titan100.biz/2022-phl-titan-100/troy-beane. * 2019 – Meritorious Service Medal, 3rd Award. * 2018 – ESGR Freedom Award - https://www.dvidshub.net/news/275195/pa-guard-member-nominates-employer-finalist-national-employer-award. * 2012 – President Benjamin Harrison Medal. * 2005 – Humanitarian Service Medal – Hurricane Katrina Relief. * 2001 – Air Force Outstanding Unit Award.
